description: React component for rendering a sidebar direct message channel in Mattermost, including profile picture, status, and leave channel functionality.

classes.name: SidebarDirectChannel
classes.description: React component for displaying a direct message channel in the sidebar, with functionality to leave the channel and display user status.

methods.name: handleLeaveChannel
methods.description: Handles the process of leaving a direct channel, updating preferences, and redirecting if active.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the profile picture component with status icon based on teammate and channel status.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the sidebar link for the direct message channel, including display name, icon, and leave handler.
